education.level: Bachelor of Technology (Electronics and Communication Engineering)

workExperience.description:
BrokeBuddy | MongoDB, Express, Node, React, Passport GitHub | Live Link
• Built a secure lending platform with role-based dashboards (borrower/lender), JWT + Google OAuth auth, loan
tracking, repayment validation, and automated email reminders using Node.js, React, MongoDB, and Tailwind CSS.
• Developed with the MERN stack and implemented email automation using Nodemailer and cron jobs.
• Integrated interest calculation, smart repayment validation, and secure route protection based on user ownership.
• Created real-time dashboards to display active loans, repayments, and transaction stats.
• Achieved seamless role switching and protected route access using JWT and Passport strategies.
• Designed a fully responsive UI with Tailwind CSS and built reusable components in React.

Job Sniff | React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Tailwind CSS GitHub | Live Link
• Developed a dual-role platform where job applicants upload resumes and HRs view and filter them based on skill
relevance.
• Used Elasticsearch to enable fast and accurate resume search with full-text matching and custom scoring logic.
• Implemented resume parsing, NLP-based keyword extraction, and ranking to improve recruiter efficiency.
• Built a clean, animated drag-and-drop upload interface with real-time dashboard updates.
• Secured role-based dashboards and API routes using JWT authentication and user context.
